events.name: BEAT: Belew/Vai/Levin/Bozzio Performing the Music of KING CRIMSON
events.info: Following more than 100 acclaimed performances across North and South America, Europe, and Japan, BEAT returns this fall for the last North American tour. Former King Crimson members Adrian Belew and Tony Levin are joined by guitar virtuoso Steve Vai and legendary drummer Terry Bozzio to perform the music of the three landmark 1980s King Crimson albums; Discipline, Beat, and Three of a Perfect Pair. Rather than attempting to recreate the original recordings, BEAT brings this extraordinary music to life with the spirit, precision, and adventurousness that made it so enduring. Whether you've lived with these albums for decades or are discovering them for the first time, this is the final opportunity to experience one of progressive music. events.name: Cincinnati Bearcats College Football vs. Utah Football
events.info: No refunds. No exchanges. Event date and time subject to change. All persons ages 4 and up must have a ticket for admission. The University of Cincinnati campus is tobacco, smoke and vape free.
events.pleaseNote: Nippert Stadium follows a clear bag policy. For more information, visit GoBearcats.com. Nippert Stadium has a no re-entry policy.

ticketLimit.info: There is an overall 8 ticket limit for this event.

venues.name: Nippert Stadium

boxOfficeInfo.phoneNumberDetail: University of Cincinnati Athletic Ticket Office: (513) 556-2287.
boxOfficeInfo.openHoursDetail: The Athletic Ticket Office is open Monday through Friday, 9:00 AM to 5:00 PM. The Stadium Box Office opens 1 1/2 hours prior to the scheduled event.
boxOfficeInfo.acceptedPaymentDetail: The Box Office accepts cash only on the day of an event.
boxOfficeInfo.willCallDetail: Will Call tickets are available for pick up 90 minutes prior to the event at the Will Call Window. Customer must have the actual credit card used for the order, a picture ID, and the confirmation number.

venues.parkingDetail: Parking is available in the garages off Martin Luther King for varying fees. Questions regarding parking may be refered to the Athletic Ticket Office.

generalInfo.generalRule: Cameras without flashes are permitted. Recording devices are permitted, but must be checked in at the Customer Service window on the East Concourse of Shoemaker Center.
generalInfo.childRule: A child in arms may sit on parents lap for free.
